word_ids: 0 is explicit story boundary; full SHA256(UTF8 normalized word) keys assigned IDs 1.. in deterministic encounter order: fixed Main manifest order, then historical train raw order, then validation raw order; never compare word IDs across independently built vocabularies
binary_format: little-endian uint32 source tokens; patterns MCF1 + uint32 count + repeated uint32 length and sequence; compiler uint64 unsigned overflow modulo 2^64
historical_model_stream_guard: Check first 120000000 old-2048 train tokens and 1000000 validation tokens as uint16 against immutable 007 manifest, without treating later full-story over-exclusion as consumed training
public_example_order: First 128 matching pattern IDs per view/length; not ranked by model quality
normalization_runtime: Record Python and Unicode database versions; no package substitution to obtain a preferred result
index_durability: Large streams, patterns, mappings and complete match counts retained locally with SHA256 manifests; no HF upload or remote persistence claimed
gate_effect: No scientific pass/fail threshold or Proof B approval introduced
